name: jianying-draft

interface.shortDescription: 草稿、字幕、音频与特效，Rust 单栈编排
interface.longDescription: Cross-host JianYing automation through one checksum-verified Rust jianying-cli Runtime Adapter. The plugin preserves Job v2 task IDs, capability gates, structured recovery, and evidence-aware delivery.

skillInstructions: 加载本插件技能时：先通过 scripts/harness.mjs doctor 完成 Rust CLI 与技能锁握手；所有执行只走 Runtime Adapter，已有草稿使用隔离副本，并如实报告证据等级。
